messages:
maria (Finance): FYI - Stripe flagged acct 0039 (DynaData) for ~27 failed card auth attempts over 2h. Stripe put a temporary payment hold. Customer is disputing ~$12,308 in usage charges. Need dispute evidence (invoices, session logs, IPs) asap.

kevin (Support): I opened ticket #4579 and pinged the customer. They say charges are 'unauthorized' and requested billing pause. Asked them for the exact timeframe. :raised_hand:

lisa (Payments Ops): I'll pull invoice PDF and raw charge IDs. Can eng share session logs + IPs for suspicious token activity?

sam (Engineering): On it. Quick overview: high-rate token creation from 3 IPs in that window - looks like card-testing + automated usage. Sample log lines: 
```
2026-02-12T03:14:22Z INFO request_id=chg_1A2B3 user_id=org_0039 model=gpt-4u tokens=1200 ip=18.205.32.12
2026-02-12T03:14:24Z INFO request_id=chg_1A2B4 user_id=org_0039 model=gpt-4u tokens=980 ip=3.134.44.77
2026-02-12T03:14:30Z INFO request_id=chg_1A2B5 user_id=org_0039 model=gpt-4u tokens=1405 ip=18.205.32.12
```

julie (Fraud): Marking as high-risk. Recommend escalation to permanent hold + full refund review if this is bot testing. We need PCI/compliance signoff before sending any full card data to Stripe.

maria (Finance): Please bundle the following for Stripe evidence: invoice_0039_20260211.pdf, logs snippet, support thread, and charge IDs (chg_1A2B3, chg_1A2B4, chg_1A2B5). I will upload to the Stripe evidence portal once we have everything.

paybot: Payment hold created -> HOLD-17655-0039. Notifying billing@redwood.

kevin (Support): Customer replied - they said charges started after a password reset on 2026-02-11. Bank dispute ref BNK-9921. They requested timeline + IPs.

lisa (Payments Ops): Uploaded invoice and CSV of charges to the finance evidence share: /shared/finance/evidence/0039.csv
Link: https://redwood.internal/s/finance/evidence/0039

maria (Finance): Thanks. Julie & Sam - if Stripe pushes for immediate refund, do we provisionally refund while investigation continues? Need legal approver for any PII we send to Stripe. @amy (Legal)

julie (Fraud): I support provisional refund if logs confirm automated card-testing usage and no legitimate activity. Legal to confirm PII sharing rules. @amy (Legal) please advise on next steps and whether we can share IP addresses + partial logs with Stripe now.

amy (Legal): Acknowledge - I'll review the logs and advise on redaction requirements. If it's non-PII (IPs, request IDs, timestamps), we can share. No PAN full numbers. Please send a secure bundle to legal@.

maria (Finance): Great - I'll assemble and upload. Will update Stripe evidence portal and follow up on ticket #4579.

kevin (Support): Keeping the customer informed: "We're investigating and have placed a temporary billing hold. We'll follow up with evidence and timeline." :pray:
